profile.headline: Frontend-Focused Full Stack Engineer | Passionate About UX & Scalable Web Architecture
profile.summary: I'm a frontend-focused full-stack engineer with over 5 years of experience building scalable, user-friendly web applications. With a background in UX design, I specialize in React, TypeScript, Next.js, and AWS, crafting intuitive and high-performance interfaces that enhance user experiences. I’ve worked in microservices architectures, integrating APIs, optimizing performance, and ensuring accessibility. I thrive in fast-paced environments, love solving complex problems, and am passionate about creating seamless digital experiences that make an impact.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
UX Design
- Worked with building design system for enterprise software
- Figma, Sketch, Adobe

Senior Web Developer
- Create WP websites to help facility marketing.
- SEO, GA4/GTAG mangament

Full Stack Engineer
- Worked with react based projects and micro-service architect. 
- using graphQL to link FE/BE
positions.insights: Skills: RESTful WebServices · AWS Lambda · PostgreSQL · AWS CloudFormation · Next.js · GraphQL · Front End Engineering Design (FEED) · Amazon S3 · Code Review · React.js · MySQL · Web Applications · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Docker

positions.title: Web Master
positions.description:
I designed and developed the current site for Tapestry LA Church, located in 1501 S. Hill St. Over the course of a little past a month, I worked with the head creative team member, and presented multiple PSD's of each page, and any new versions of the pages once the team discussed it. 

I developed the site using the Wordpress CMS, and DIVI theme. I used a custom child theme of Divi, and made the theme it's own Tapestry Theme.

positions.title: Content Strategy/Management Associate
positions.description:
UXPA (formerly UPA) is the leading professional service organization for UX professionals internationally.

The goal of this group is to support the Los Angeles user experience professional community in advancing our knowledge and use of usability best practices. We are an official chapter of the User Experience Professionals Association International (UXPA).

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description: In charge of Site maintenance (DNS management,SEO optimization, and troubleshooting), Shopify App modifications, and product management.

positions.title: UX/UI Bootcamp
positions.description: I completed a 6 month UX/UI bootcamp where I got to learn and practice the philosophy of Human-Centered design, and refine my design process.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I collaborate with other developers in bringing to life what's on PSDs, to the world.

positions.title: Junior Web Developer
positions.description: I was in charge of maintaining and updating all current client sites, and to develop new responsive sites, from local, to staging, to production.
